// ADR-284 §7a acceptance set — plants rebuilt in the builder, generated by packages/shared/src/codeView/generate.ts.
// Golden output of apps/builder/src/preview/catalog/__tests__/adr284CodeView.test.tsx (UPDATE_CODE_VIEW=1 rewrites).

import {useState} from 'react';
import {useCollator, useFilter} from 'react-aria';
import {Button, Checkbox, GridList, GridListItem, Row, SearchField, Table, TagGroup, type Selection, type SortDescriptor} from 'react-aria-components';
import plants from './data/plants';

export default function Home() {
  let [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  let [favorite, setFavorite] = useState(false);
  let [cycles, setCycles] = useState<Selection>(new Set());
  let [sunlight, setSunlight] = useState<Selection>(new Set());
  let [watering, setWatering] = useState<Selection>(new Set());
  let [sortDescriptor, setSortDescriptor] = useState<SortDescriptor>({column: 'id', direction: 'ascending'});
  let {contains} = useFilter({sensitivity: 'base'});
  let collator = useCollator();
  let sortDescriptorDir = sortDescriptor.direction === 'descending' ? -1 : 1;
  let items = plants
    .filter(item =>
      (contains(String(item.common_name), search) || item.scientific_name.some(x => contains(String(x), search))) &&
      (!favorite || item.isFavorite === true) &&
      (cycles === 'all' || cycles.size === 0 || cycles.has(item.cycle)) &&
      (sunlight === 'all' || sunlight.size === 0 || sunlight.has(item.sunlight)) &&
      (watering === 'all' || watering.size === 0 || watering.has(item.watering)))
    .toSorted((a, b) => collator.compare(String(a[sortDescriptor.column]), String(b[sortDescriptor.column])) * sortDescriptorDir);

  return (
    <>
      <SearchField label="common_name" value={search} onChange={setSearch} />
      <Checkbox isSelected={favorite} onChange={setFavorite}>isFavorite</Checkbox>
      <TagGroup label="cycle" selectedKeys={cycles} onSelectionChange={setCycles} />
      <TagGroup label="sunlight" selectedKeys={sunlight} onSelectionChange={setSunlight} />
      <TagGroup label="watering" selectedKeys={watering} onSelectionChange={setWatering} />
      <Table sortDescriptor={sortDescriptor} onSortChange={setSortDescriptor} items={items}>
        {item => <Row id={item.id} textValue={String(item.id)}>{item.id}</Row>}
      </Table>
      <GridList items={items}>
        {item => <GridListItem id={item.id} textValue={String(item.id)}>{item.id}</GridListItem>}
      </GridList>
      <Button label="Clear filters" onPress={() => {
        setFavorite(false);
        setCycles(new Set());
        setSunlight(new Set());
        setWatering(new Set());
      }} />
    </>
  );
}
